migration_rules: Canonical functional names are the only names for new source, routing and documentation.
A Service and its owning Deployment may share the same canonical name because Kubernetes kinds are distinct.
context-forwarder is a loopback sidecar component, not a separately exposed Service.
Keep legacy Services as compatibility aliases until source pipelines and every external watcher are verified migrated.
Do not mutate immutable Deployment selectors; replacement requires coordinated recovery window.
Do not change actual third-party package names, image references, upstream URLs or historical evidence.
Canonical names do not prove rollout, engine correctness or source provenance.
